item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Azure Functions OpenAI Extension ends on April 20, 2027
item.description:
Support for the Azure Functions OpenAI extension ends on April 20, 2027. Users should migrate to the appropriate direct SDKs before that date, including OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, or Azure AI Search SDKs depending on the scenario.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
item.description:
GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says both are intended for agentic coding and code review, with stronger coding judgment than earlier GPT-6 models.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6.1 Terra in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for everyday agentic coding and terminal work, and costs less than GPT-6.1 Sol.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6.1 Sol in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6.1 Sol is now generally available and rolling out in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it can be used for agentic coding and terminal workflows with strong multistep performance.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna now available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now includes two additional OpenAI GPT-6 models: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. They join the previously available GPT-6 Astra as selectable model options.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says the model is intended for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks.

  • Source: GitHub
